objectives.text: Hear the innkeeper out at the crossroads
Drive the bandits off the road

pages.name: The innkeeper's worry
pages.text:
“Hesk hasn't brought a sack of flour in a week, and Hesk never misses market day. The mill's an hour east along the old road, past the woods. I'll stand you all a month of suppers if you bring him back.”

Take the mill road: @scene[mill-road]{The Mill Road}.
